mutants.method: Each mutation was written into temporary source files. A subprocess executed the current guardian against those files. A nonzero exit caused by AssertionError was required; loader failures and timeouts did not count as kills.

exactUndo.method: Modified files return exactly to immutable base, preserving unrelated prefix/suffix bytes, mixed EOL, CRLF and Windows paths. Corrupted or repeated task hunks are rejected. Exact new files project to absence; a later-modified new file is retained by refusing deletion.

limits: No env files, live credentials, live database, real network submission or paid render were used.
This receipt covers the focused guardian and exact undo; the complete historical suite and tsc have separate receipts.
Local simulated execution does not prove deployment, actual indexing or commercial conversion.
